products.name: Real Estate ERP Core
products.description: The Bloxs-style system of record for real estate organisations, bundling the Relaties, Objecten, Contracten, Financieel and Rapportages modules: one contact database for tenants, owners, investors, suppliers and accountants; portfolios, complexes and rental units of every type with valuations and market data; vacancy, letting and candidate screening with rent-price compliance checks; lease contracts captured once and signed digitally with automated indexation, renewals, terminations and service charge settlements; periodic rent runs, direct debit, bank reconciliation, debtor management and dunning; and a multi-entity real estate general ledger with accounts payable, VAT and period close. Sold as a subscription per organisation that scales with modules and portfolio size, with implementation, data migration, training and unlimited support.

products.name: Technical Management Suite
products.description: The Techniek module for technical and maintenance managers: fault reports and tickets from tenants, portals and e-mail triaged into work orders; supplier dispatch with quotes, planning and completion reporting, including the Ziezodan and Proprli partner connectors for automated maintenance handling; installation registers with automatic supplier reminders for periodic inspections and maintenance; and multi-year maintenance plans (MJOP) with budgets per complex and unit. Extends the ERP core with a field app for inspections and on-site work and feeds supplier invoices straight into accounts payable.

products.name: Owners' Association (VvE) Suite
products.description: The Informant-heritage administration module for owners' associations (VvE): association budgets, owner contributions and reserve funds per association; direct-debit collection and arrears follow-up of contributions; meeting preparation, agendas, decisions and minutes; owner communication and documents; and association accounts kept as separate legal entities in the multi-entity ledger. Gives VvE administrators one workspace for every association they manage and gives apartment owners a self-service VvE owner portal for statements, meetings and documents. Informant customers migrate onto this module free of charge under the phased integration plan.

products.name: Tenant, Owner and Supplier Portals and Apps
products.description: The Portalen add-on: branded self-service portals and apps with real-time information from the ERP. Tenants pay rent, see their contract, invoices and service charge statements, report faults and follow their ticket in the tenant portal and iOS/Android app; private owners see how their property performs, approve quotes and expenses, and download statements and documents in the owner portal; maintenance suppliers receive and accept work orders, submit quotes, plan visits, report completion and invoice in the supplier portal. Every portal action lands directly in the organisation's tickets, contracts and ledger, so both sides save handling time and avoid re-keying.

products.name: Projects and Development Finance
products.description: The Projecten module for the financial management of new-build, renovation and transformation projects: project budgets and phases, commitments and purchase orders against suppliers and contractors, cost tracking and forecasts against budget, project documents and milestone monitoring, and the hand-over of a delivered building into exploitation as objects and units in the portfolio. Keeps project costs in the same multi-entity ledger as the exploitation accounts so asset managers and controllers see capex and returns in one place.

products.name: Data Analytics and Investor Reporting
products.description: The Rapportages and data analytics layer on top of the integrated real estate data model: standard real-estate reports customised per employee, interactive dashboards on occupancy, rent growth, arrears, yield and maintenance, valuations and market analysis, forecasts and asset plans, and periodic investor, lender and owner reporting packs generated from the closed ledger. Includes Power BI connectors so investors and directors can steer on the same figures as the finance team without a reporting project.

products.name: API Platform and Certified Integrations
products.description: The connectivity foundation sold as the API Platform add-on module: an open, standardised REST API with API keys, webhooks and developer documentation for the organisation's own systems and integrators, plus the catalogue of certified integrations - accounting packages, bank connections for direct debit and statement import, BI tools such as Power BI, e-mail with Gmail and Microsoft Outlook, e-signing, maintenance partners such as Ziezodan and Proprli, and rent-price compliance via Huurprijscheck.app. Lets finance controllers and directors keep their existing toolchain while the ERP remains the single source of truth.

products.name: Hyper Automation and AI Assistants
products.description: The hyper automation foundation - AI and robotics that fully process repetitive tasks under human supervision: robots that run rent invoicing, direct-debit batches, bank reconciliation, supplier invoice coding and indexation letters on schedule, and AI assistants that draft correspondence and documents, code incoming invoices, triage the shared inbox and fault reports, and answer tenant and owner questions from the record. One published testimonial reports 100% time savings on repetitive financial processes; the add-on is the lever behind units-per-FTE growth for property managers and controllers.
